command: set -euo pipefail; IDF_ROOT="${HOME}/esp/esp-idf"; PARENT="$(dirname "$IDF_ROOT")"; TMP="${PARENT}/esp-idf.v5.5.4-fresh"; BACKUP="${PARENT}/esp-idf.pre-v5.5.4-backup"; test -d "$TMP/.git"; mv "$IDF_ROOT" "$BACKUP"; mv "$TMP" "$IDF_ROOT"; CLEAN_PATH='/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin'; env -u VIRTUAL_ENV -u CONDA_PREFIX -u PYTHONHOME PATH="$CLEAN_PATH" bash "$IDF_ROOT/install.sh" esp32s3; unset VIRTUAL_ENV CONDA_PREFIX PYTHONHOME || true; export PATH="$CLEAN_PATH"; source "$IDF_ROOT/export.sh"; idf.py --version | tee /tmp/idf-version-v554-recovery.txt; grep -Eq 'ESP-IDF v5\.5\.4($|[- ])' /tmp/idf-version-v554-recovery.txt; test "$(git -C "$IDF_ROOT" describe --tags --exact-match HEAD)" = 'v5.5.4'; test -z "$(git -C "$IDF_ROOT" status --porcelain --untracked-files=normal)"
